metadata.description: Visit every active National Basketball Association home arena across the United States and Canada.
metadata.author: Journey

journey.name: NBA Stadiums
journey.description: Visit all 30 active National Basketball Association home arenas across the United States and Canada, from historic Madison Square Garden and TD Garden to modern landmarks such as Chase Center and Intuit Dome.

items.name: State Farm Arena
items.description: Home of the Atlanta Hawks, this downtown arena anchors Atlanta's sports and entertainment district near Centennial Olympic Park.

items.name: TD Garden
items.description: Home of the Boston Celtics, this downtown arena sits above North Station and carries one of professional basketball's richest traditions.

items.name: Barclays Center
items.description: Home of the Brooklyn Nets, this distinctive arena anchors the Atlantic Yards development in central Brooklyn.

items.name: Spectrum Center
items.description: Home of the Charlotte Hornets, this uptown arena places basketball in the heart of Charlotte's business and entertainment district.

items.name: United Center
items.description: Home of the Chicago Bulls, this large West Side arena celebrates Chicago basketball history with championship banners and iconic statues.

items.name: Rocket Arena
items.description: Home of the Cleveland Cavaliers, this downtown arena sits beside Progressive Field and hosts basketball, concerts, and major events.

items.name: American Airlines Center
items.description: Home of the Dallas Mavericks, this downtown arena blends brick architecture with the lively Victory Park district.

items.name: Ball Arena
items.description: Home of the Denver Nuggets, this downtown arena sits near the South Platte River and serves as a major Rocky Mountain sports venue.

items.name: Little Caesars Arena
items.description: Home of the Detroit Pistons, this modern downtown venue is part of the District Detroit sports and entertainment corridor.

items.name: Chase Center
items.description: Home of the Golden State Warriors, this waterfront San Francisco arena anchors the Mission Bay entertainment district.

items.name: Toyota Center
items.description: Home of the Houston Rockets, this downtown arena is a central destination for basketball, concerts, and major events.

items.name: Gainbridge Fieldhouse
items.description: Home of the Indiana Pacers, this downtown fieldhouse draws on Indiana's basketball heritage with an intimate, basketball-focused design.

items.name: Intuit Dome
items.description: Home of the LA Clippers, this advanced Inglewood arena features The Wall fan section, extensive technology, and a basketball-first design.

items.name: Crypto.com Arena
items.description: Home of the Los Angeles Lakers, this downtown arena is a centerpiece of L.A. Live and one of the country's best-known basketball stages.

items.name: FedExForum
items.description: Home of the Memphis Grizzlies, this downtown arena stands near Beale Street and celebrates the city's music and basketball culture.

items.name: Kaseya Center
items.description: Home of the Miami Heat, this waterfront downtown arena overlooks Biscayne Bay and delivers a distinctly South Florida atmosphere.

items.name: Fiserv Forum
items.description: Home of the Milwaukee Bucks, this modern downtown arena anchors the Deer District and reflects Milwaukee's championship basketball revival.

items.name: Target Center
items.description: Home of the Minnesota Timberwolves, this downtown Minneapolis arena is connected to the city's entertainment district and skyway system.

items.name: Smoothie King Center
items.description: Home of the New Orleans Pelicans, this arena stands beside the Caesars Superdome in the city's central sports district.

items.name: Madison Square Garden
items.description: Home of the New York Knicks, this landmark Manhattan arena sits above Penn Station and is one of basketball's most famous venues.

items.name: Paycom Center
items.description: Home of the Oklahoma City Thunder, this downtown arena is known for enthusiastic crowds and a strong connection to the surrounding community.

items.name: Kia Center
items.description: Home of the Orlando Magic, this downtown arena offers modern amenities and serves as a major Central Florida sports and entertainment venue.

items.name: Xfinity Mobile Arena
items.description: Home of the Philadelphia 76ers, this South Philadelphia arena is part of the city's major sports complex and one of its busiest event venues.

items.name: Footprint Center
items.description: Home of the Phoenix Suns, this downtown arena sits beside Chase Field and delivers a modern desert-city basketball experience.

items.name: Moda Center
items.description: Home of the Portland Trail Blazers, this Rose Quarter arena is known for loyal fans and a distinctive Pacific Northwest basketball atmosphere.

items.name: Golden 1 Center
items.description: Home of the Sacramento Kings, this downtown arena is integrated into the city's DOCO entertainment district and features a highly connected design.

items.name: Frost Bank Center
items.description: Home of the San Antonio Spurs, this arena reflects the franchise's championship history and strong connection to South Texas.

items.name: Scotiabank Arena
items.description: Home of the Toronto Raptors, this downtown arena stands beside Union Station and serves as Canada's premier NBA stage.

items.name: Delta Center
items.description: Home of the Utah Jazz, this downtown Salt Lake City arena is renowned for loud crowds and a long-running mountain-state basketball tradition.

items.name: Capital One Arena
items.description: Home of the Washington Wizards, this downtown arena anchors the Penn Quarter and Chinatown entertainment district in the nation's capital.
